title: Inspections every plan must include
heading: A Row Leaves Each Variable Only What the Others Must Use
cases: an inspection without which a district cannot get its hours is fixed at 1
an inspection that does not fit next to the forced ones is fixed at 0
a fixing at 0 lowers what a district can get, which can force more inspections in a later round
an inspection that brings spending exactly to the budget still fits
with the fixings applied the optimum is unchanged and the LP bound is lower
